paper_title: Searching for axion-like particles with ultra-peripheral heavy-ion collisions
coupling_convention: 1/Lambda in GeV^-1 (operator (1/4)(a/Lambda)F Ftilde, equivalent to g_agamma)
notes: Projection/sensitivity study for ALP-photon coupling (aF F-tilde) via ultra-peripheral Pb-Pb collisions at LHC, with a Z^4-enhanced gamma-gamma luminosity. Main result is projected sensitivity for 1 nb^-1 (and 10 nb^-1) Pb-Pb runs, y-axis 1/Lambda in GeV^-1 (= g_agamma) vs ma in GeV (5-100 GeV). Values are approximate estimates read off Fig.4 (left, F F-tilde operator) for the 1 nb^-1 curve; anchored by injected-signal reference points (ma=15 GeV, Lambda=17 TeV -> 1/Lambda=5.9e-5; ma=40 GeV, Lambda=8 TeV -> 1.25e-4 at 5 nb). Paper also presents recast/new limits from OPAL (LEPII) and ATLAS multi-photon searches. Masses converted GeV->eV.
